name: Mahad Ashtavinayak
problem: Temple dedication is listed as 'Vighneshwara' but Mahad's Ashtavinayak is actually dedicated to 'Varadvinayak'. Vighneshwara is located at Ozar (7th in sequence).
suggested_fix: Change dedication from 'Vighneshwara' to 'Varadvinayak (the wish-fulfilling Ganesha)'

name: Pali Ashtavinayak
problem: Temple at Pali is listed as 'Third Ashtavinayak temple dedicated to Girijatmaja' but Pali actually hosts Ballaleshwar (3rd in sequence). Girijatmaj is the 6th Ashtavinayak, located at Lenyadri, not Pali.
evidence: Official Ashtavinayak sequence: Pali = Ballaleshwar (3rd). Girijatmaj = Lenyadri (6th, carved into cave 8 with 307 steps). Source: https://www.shreeballaleshwarpali.org/ and https://www.ashtavinayak.in/lenyadri-girijatmaj-ganpati-ashtavinayak.php
suggested_fix: Change 'Girijatmaja' to 'Ballaleshwar (the wish-granting Ganesha)', noting that Pali is the 3rd in sequence

name: Srirangapatna Fort Walls
problem: Description states '16th-century fort' but historical sources indicate the fort was fortified in the 15th century, with later Tipu Sultan renovations in the 18th century.
evidence: Fort fortification began 15th century; Tipu Sultan renovated and strengthened the fort in 18th century. British breached walls in 1799. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seringapatam and https://www.britannica.com/place/Srirangapatna
suggested_fix: Change '16th-century fort' to '15th-century fort (renovated by Tipu Sultan in the 18th century)'
